COMPLETE.description: The analysis completed and produced its required outputs.

COMPLETE_EMPTY_RESULT.description: The analysis completed correctly but found no reportable records.

NOT_RUN_DISABLED.description: The optional analysis was disabled by configuration.

NOT_RUN_NO_EXPLICIT_CONTRAST.description: No biological comparison was requested explicitly.

NOT_RUN_INSUFFICIENT_REPLICATION.description: The design did not meet the minimum biological-replication requirement.

NOT_RUN_INVALID_DESIGN.description: The requested statistical design or contrast was not estimable.

NOT_RUN_NO_EVENTS.description: No applicable events were available for this analysis.

NOT_AVAILABLE_SPARSE_INPUT.description: The input was valid but too sparse for the tool-native analysis.

PREDICTION_NOT_AVAILABLE_SPARSE_INPUT.description: ORF candidates were retained, but reliable primary prediction was unavailable for sparse input.

NO_TRANSCRIPTS.description: The required workflow completed but no transcript models were present.

FAILED.description: A required technical stage or contract failed.
